newsitem.title: UK: UK money market rates soften, shortages seen easing.
newsitem.headline: UK money market rates soften, shortages seen easing.

text.p: UK money market rates softened as a hefty 1.45 billion stg liquidity shortage was comfortably taken out by the Bank of England and traders said shortages were expected to remain manageable for the rest of the week.
* Overnight cash ended at 5-3/4 percent, having touched a low of around 5-1/4.
* In the gilt repo market, the 8.0 percent gilts due 2003 remained the main special stock, quoted around 3.0 percent.
* 7.0 percent gilts due 2001 continued to attract interest in the one month at around 4.75 percent.
* the auction of three billion stg of 8.0 percent gilts due 2021 failed to generate any extra activity in existing stocks.
* one-week GC was quoted at 5.77 72 and one month at 5.76 71
